guild_slime_cleanup.description: Slimes have been appearing outside the town walls. Clear them before they become a problem.

dialogue.offer: We've had reports of slimes gathering outside the walls. Take care of three of them and report back.
dialogue.accepted: Good. The Guild is counting on you.
dialogue.declined: Come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.active: The slimes are still outside the walls.
dialogue.ready: Good work. The road should be safer now.
dialogue.completed: Your work has made the roads safer.
